title: Food Safety and Standards (Ayurveda Aahar) Regulations, 2022

sections.section: Regulation 3 - Definition & Scope of Ayurveda Aahar
sections.content: Ayurveda Aahar refers to food prepared in accordance with recipes/processes listed in authoritative books of Ayurveda specified in Schedule A of Drugs and Cosmetics Act. It excludes synthetic vitamins, parenteral administration, or Schedule H drug additives.

Every package of Ayurveda Aahar shall prominently display the special Ayurveda Aahar logo, target consumer category, recommended usage duration, and mandatory advisory statement: 'Ayurveda Aahar product - Not for medicinal use'.
